figurative_meaning_en: To speak harshly; to reprimand or scold
similar_in_english: Give someone a piece of one's mind
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার ছেলেকে কথা শোনালো ভুলের জন্য।
বস অফিসে সবাইকে কড়া কথা শোনালেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He gave his son a talking-to for his mistake.
The boss reprimanded everyone in the office.
note: This idiom reflects everyday Bengali conversational style for expressing disapproval.
